name: Regolith ground
$comment: A patch of the shared Earth (assets/bodies/earth.json) at the declared lat/lon; its gravity, air and material strata all derive from that one body. NOT A SHIPPED SCENE: the browser Ground scene was deleted 2026-08-03 (docs/63 item 1 — it declared lat 45, lon -100 and then invented its own relief, 'a real place with imaginary ground'). This file survives as the fixture that proves the ENGINE can still build a ground patch from a definition: simulation.rs, site.rs and lib.rs all read it. The capability outlives the diorama.
